# Java LTS Migration
Migrate Java 8 to Java 21 or 25 using discovery, baseline, incremental migration, validation, and reporting.
Inspect Java/toolchain, Maven or Gradle, dependencies, plugins, annotation processors, JVM options, tests, Jib/Docker and CI.
Preserve behavior. Identify removed/deprecated APIs, reflection issues, JAXB and javax/jakarta compatibility. Do not claim success without compile and test evidence.
Validate compile, unit tests, integration tests, packaging, container build and application startup where applicable.
Report baseline, target version, required changes, dependency risks, test results and remaining work.
